overview: A one-page State Department file index for material concerning foreign-exchange control in Japanese-ruled Taiwan. It records a January 19, 1937 communication from Taihoku that transmitted copies of the Taiwan Government General Official Gazette of December 1, 1936, containing amendments to exchange-control legislation, together with copies of the original law and regulations; the indexed communication and its enclosures are not included in the supplied text.

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning exchange control in Taiwan
subfiles.about: The index records a communication from Taihoku enclosing Taiwanese exchange-control legislation and amendments published in the colonial government gazette.
subfiles.summary: This filing sheet identifies the subject as “Exchange - Taiwan.” It notes that a January 19, 1937 communication from Taihoku enclosed copies of the Taiwan Government General Official Gazette dated December 1, 1936, which contained amendments to laws and regulations controlling foreign exchange. Copies of the original law and regulations were also reportedly enclosed, but neither the communication nor the enclosures appear in the supplied file text.

interest: The page is useful as evidence of U.S. diplomatic monitoring of monetary and exchange-control policy in Japanese colonial Taiwan. Although the substantive despatch and legal enclosures are absent, the index identifies their nature and dates and points researchers toward the December 1, 1936 issue of the Taiwan Government General Official Gazette. It also preserves the State Department’s internal routing notation and the colonial-era place name Taihoku for present-day Taipei.
